label: Part 1 follow-up: calibrated shrinkage of gated node values

design.operation: P'_i = (1-lambda)*P_i + lambda*mu, mu = per-seed pool mean over all 11,613 nodes (transductive pool); applied to the 2,904 gated nodes only
design.calibration: lambda* = argmin mean per-molecule |MAE delta| over the 102 VAL molecules (Mode A); test-population results reported at lambda*
design.note: Mode A == Mode B exactly for this linear operation (verified); lambda=1 = part3_strengthened shrink_poolmean arm; lambda=0 = no-op baseline

summary.caveat: best_lambda_per_population is in-sample (test) optimization and overstates; the honest single-hyperparameter result is at_lambda_star
